verdict.rationale: Jules docs say it provides a diff of changes so you can browse and approve code edits (jules-docs-7) before it creates a PR (jules-docs-8). The API notes that no PR is created automatically by default (jules-docs-11), and plan approval adds another gate before any code changes (jules-docs-4, jules-docs-17). Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the diff-review UI (inline comments, partial approval, requesting revisions), and independent hands-on reports of the pre-PR diff approval step, since community posts only describe reviewing PRs afterward.
